requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals for FY 1962-1992 -- the seven accounting variables (OPINC, AT, AR/rect, INV/invt, CAO/aco, AP, CLO/lco) plus PPE, INT, AO, LO and goodwill for the indirect-method accruals, GrNOA decomposition, and footnote filters.
Footnote/audit codes for the unclassified-balance-sheet and accounting-change filters (paper §III footnote 9 step 1 + step 2) -- these come from comp_202601.funda_fncd, paired to each line item.
Point-in-time CRSP-Compustat link for FY 1962-1992 (linktype in [LC,LU], linkprim in [P,C], usedflag=1) so that we can attach CRSP permno information to each firm-year and apply SHRCD/HN filters.

Monthly CRSP stock data for SHRCD/EXCHCD filters and pre-/post-year stock returns needed to construct the BHAR for the Mishkin (1983) test in Table 7 -- 1962 through 1993 (to span the +1 window for 1992 fiscal-year firms).
Point-in-time CRSP header records for share code (shrcd) and exchange code (exchcd) filtering at fiscal-year-end.
Pre-aggregated NYSE/AMEX size-decile portfolios for size-matched BHAR (paper §VI: 'the market-capitalization-based portfolio decile to which the firm belongs').
Fama-French research factors -- not used in the main regressions but needed for context

blocking_issues.reason: erdport1 / mport1 carry pre-sorted deciles with numeric sort criteria that are not perfectly transparent in the catalog (no explicit 'dec_rank' / 'size_decile' column). Without verified docs on which table number corresponds to size-decile portfolios, we will compute the size decile ourselves from CRSP msf market equity at fiscal-year-end instead of relying on mport1.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Compute size decile inline from (permno, year) using CRSP msf shrout*prc at the last trading day of each calendar year (or June of fyear) -- this matches the paper's 'market-capitalization-based portfolio decile to which the firm belongs' phrasing exactly. Document the choice in assumptions.md.

blocking_issues.reason: Although comp_202601.funda_fncd exists in the catalog, the modern WRDS post-2014 footnote codes (opthe, ifootnote) do not match the original COMPUSTAT 1999 Industrial file footnote codes referenced in footnote 9 of the paper. The 364 / 2,059 / 597 firm-year elimination steps cannot be replicated exactly without the legacy 1999-specific codes. Approximation: drop firm-years where any of the required line items has a footnote flag indicating 'estimated', which yields an approximately comparable sample.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Apply an approximate footnote filter using comp_202601.funda_fncd -- drop firm-years where any of at / rect / invt / aco / ap / lco / oiadp / dp has a non-zero / non-null audit footnote. Document the substitution and the resulting sample-size impact in assumptions.md.
